title: Redstrike Lab Manifest
description: The HONESTY LAYER for a reconstructed LOCAL lab (emitted by the lab-reconstruct capability into engagements/<id>/lab/lab_manifest.json). Each reconstructed service/image/version records the RECON FIELD + CONFIDENCE that justified it, the reconstruction MODE (this MVP emits white-box-exact only), and a FIDELITY TIER — so a consumer always knows what is a white-box-exact rebuild of the real code vs an inferred backing stub, and never mistakes the replica for the live target. IRON GUARDRAIL: the lab is NEVER an oracle. Anything developed or observed on the lab is replica-only and must be RE-CONFIRMED benignly on the live authorized target before it can become a finding; a replica NEGATIVE never marks a class exhausted. The manifest holds no secret values — only redacted fingerprints.

engagement.description: engagement id this lab was reconstructed for.

scope_ref.description: path to the engagement scope.yaml the rebuild was authorized under.

mode.description: the reconstruction mode. white-box-exact = the app is built from the engagement's cloned source/ and pinned to the real dependency lockfile (this MVP emits ONLY this). black-box-facade (HTTP-replay / stub-route lab from http_history) is RESERVED for a future capability and MUST NOT be emitted here.

never_an_oracle.description: a baked-in assertion that the producer and consumer both accept the IRON GUARDRAIL: the lab is replica-only, a lab observation is development-only until re-confirmed benignly on the live authorized target, and a replica negative never closes a vuln class. Always true; its presence makes the guardrail part of the artifact, not just prose.

source_ref.description: the cloned source tree the app image is built from, e.g. engagements/<id>/source — white-box-exact mode only.

lockfile.description: the dependency lockfile the app image is pinned to (ground truth for exact versions, over any banner/Server header).

name.description: e.g. composer.lock / package-lock.json / yarn.lock / poetry.lock / Gemfile.lock

path.description: path within the cloned source tree.

services.description: one entry per reconstructed container: the app (built from source/) plus one backing service per detected open port (db/cache/mail/search).

name.description: compose service name, e.g. app / db / cache / mail / search.

role.description: what the service stands in for in the rebuilt topology.

image.description: the base image at the evidenced framework+version, e.g. php:8.1-apache / mysql:8.0 / redis:7 — a TARGET-DESCRIPTIVE FACT derived from recon, not a credited external source.

version.description: the pinned framework/service version this image reconstructs.

stub.description: true = a stand-in backing service (not the target's real code); false = the app image built from the cloned source. A stub reproduces the PROTOCOL/role, not the target's data or config.

build.description: present ONLY when the service is BUILT from the cloned source (the app); OMIT this key for a pulled backing-service image.

dockerfile.description: the Dockerfile emitted for this service, relative to lab/ (e.g. Dockerfile).

justification.description: WHY this service/image/version was chosen — the recon field + confidence + mode + fidelity tier that justify it. This is the honesty record: an inferred stub is labelled as such, never dressed up as the real thing.

recon_field.description: the EXACT recon field that justified this choice, e.g. 'host_discovery.live_hosts[].ports[].service=mysql@3306', 'source_context.dependencies[php].version=8.1', 'cve_intel.components[].name=redis version=7.0'.

recon_source.description: which consumed artifact the recon_field came from.

confidence.description: how firmly recon pins this service/image/version. high = evidenced by a lockfile pin or a service+version banner; medium = evidenced by presence + a strong version signal; low = inferred from an open port with no version evidence.

mode.description: must equal the root mode; white-box-exact for every service in this MVP.

fidelity_tier.description: how faithful this reconstruction is. exact-pin = the app built from the real cloned source pinned to the real lockfile. version-matched = a backing image at a version evidenced from recon. inferred-stub = a backing service inferred from an open port whose exact product/version was NOT evidenced. placeholder = recon gave only the role's presence, not its identity — a minimal stand-in.

ports.description: the open target port(s) that triggered this backing service (from host_discovery live_hosts[].ports[]).

redacted_secret_fingerprints.description: fingerprints ONLY (never values) of any real secret recon surfaced for this service — recorded so the lab uses a fresh benign test secret in its place, never the client's real credential.

unresolved.description: honest gaps: roles/ports/versions recon surfaced that could NOT be justified into a faithful service (so the lab is known-incomplete here, not silently clean).

guardrail.description: the human-readable IRON GUARDRAIL restated for anyone reading the manifest directly (mirrors lab/README.md + the SKILL.md ## Safety section + verify-base.md): replica-only, re-confirm benignly on the live target, a replica negative never closes a class.
